questions.q: How long did the revelation pause according to the strongest view?
questions.explain: The Prophet SAW processed Waraqah's information and repeated Al-Alaq.

options: The one wrapped in a cloak, a gentle address to the Prophet SAW

questions.q: What did the Prophet SAW see between the heaven and the earth?
options: The same angel seated on a chair
questions.explain: He fell down trembling and went home asking to be covered.

questions.q: What does ruj mean in Al-Muddaththir?
options: Foul words and deeds, including idol worship
questions.explain: Shun ruj and avoid foul words when criticised.

options: Reciting the Quran slowly and clearly
questions.explain: The Prophet SAW was commanded to recite the Quran with tartil.

questions.q: The Prophet's SAW sadness shows he gave up hope.
questions.explain: False. Sorrow is not the same as despair.

questions.q: The path of da'wah is always easy and never makes us want to quit.
questions.explain: False. The path of da'wah is hard and has its ups and downs, so be patient.

questions.q: Put these events in the right order.

items.text: The verses to arise and warn descend
He goes home asking to be covered
He sees the angel on the chair
He grieves and longs for revelation

questions.explain: Revelation paused, he grieved, saw the angel, went home covered, and the verses of warning came down.

questions.q: Match each term with its meaning.

right.text: Reminding of a gift so as to nullify its reward
A name of Allah, the ceaseless Bestower

questions.explain: Fatrat al-wahy is the pause, mann is reminding of favours, andhir is warn, and Al-Mannan is a name of Allah.

questions.q: Before correcting others, what should we do?
options: Check ourselves and our own way of life first
